title.narrative: 22F-SEGES - Partnership for Green and Productive Dairy in Nigeria

description.narrative: DGBP-2022. Partnership for Green and Productive Dairy in Nigeria

The overall objective of the Partnership for Green and Productive Dairy in Nigeria is to establish a climate resilient, green and productive dairy value chain in Nigeria. The project first and foremost builds on a strong and solid business case between Arla Foods as the commercial partner and SEGES Innovation, Danish Agriculture and Food Council, CORET and Milk Value Chain Foundation as the non-commercial development partners.
The Danida Green Business Partnerships (DGBP) programme funds and supports market-based partnership projects between commercial and non-commercial partners addressing climate and environmental challenges while contributing to inclusive growth and improved livelihoods. The programme builds on previous years’ experience with the private partnership program, DMDP.
